svg.title: Viewer — stereo viewer robot
svg.desc: A brown bakelite robot whose head is a stereo slide viewer, its eyes looking out through two round eyepieces, with a slide reel standing upright in the slot on top and an advance lever on its side, a rounded torso with a pocket of spare reels, jointed arms with pincers and jointed legs on flat feet.
